title: Revising Auslander-Gruson-Jensen duality
summary: For a ring $A$ there is a well-known duality between definable subcategories of right $A$-modules and definable subcategories of left $A$ modules. This is a consequence of Auslander-Gruson-Jensen duality $\rm mod\text{-}(mod\text{-}A)\rightarrow mod\text{-}(mod\text{-}A^{op})$. The existence of this duality arises from the fact that $\rm mod\text{-}(mod\text{-}A)$ is the free abelian category over the pre-additive category $A$ with a single object.
